title: L5 memory record (front matter of Store/<slug>.md and Archive/<slug>.md)
description: One memory per file. Front matter is one `key: value` per line; non-string values are JSON. The body is the description, then the [[links]]. Files hold states; continuous scores (R) are computed, never stored.

name.description: Slug, also the file name. Unique across Store and Archive.

description.description: The fact, one plain sentence written about the subject.

subject.description: Entity anchor: a person or a thing, never a phrase. Drives recall adjacency.

said_by.description: Source tier for CONTRADICT: owner > task > inferred.

salience.description: Ranking input for the hot budget; set at write.

last_reinforced.description: Last real touch: a recall or a restatement. Never a file mtime.

reinforcements.description: Grows stability: S = S0 x min(1.8^n, 10).

days.description: Distinct days this memory was seen. Drives episode->fact promotion (3+) and REFLECT evidence.

valid_to.description: Set when superseded: the day the fact stopped being current.

links.description: Slugs of linked memories, written both ways by LINK and REFLECT.

evidence.description: Up to 12 quoted words from the transcript that justify the memory.

pinned.description: Exempt from decay and archival, like a rule.

forgotten.description: Forgotten on request: lives in Archive, never recalled.
